title: Google June 2026 Android Update Patches 124 Flaws, One Actively Exploited
summary: Google on Monday released patches for 124 security vulnerabilities impacting its Android operating system for the month of June 2026, including one high-severity flaw in the Framework component that has come under active exploitation.
